title: Badminton | Calm Joints
description: A short badminton kit for between matches, and a video assessment with a registered physiotherapist.
sub: Badminton asks a lot of shoulders, wrists, knees and ankles: overhead smashes, deep lunges, fast changes of direction. Here’s a short kit for between matches, and a video assessment with a registered physiotherapist if you’d like to talk through how you move.
